name: AMR Memory
description: Native AI Memory Runtime (AMR) plugin for OpenClaw with Zero-VRAM prefetch and session ingestion

socketPath.description: Path to AMR Unix Domain Socket. Defaults to $AMR_SOCKET_PATH or /run/user/<uid>/qdrant-bge.sock

deadlineMs.description: Hard deadline in milliseconds for memory prefetch before socket destruction

scoreThreshold.description: Minimum similarity score threshold for recalling memories

maxItemChars.description: Maximum characters allowed per single memory item before truncation

maxTotalChars.description: Hard upper bound of characters allowed for total injected recalled context

projectId.description: Optional default project ID to scope memory recall and ingestion
